title: Elf Bar JoinOne Lemon Lime Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Lemon Lime delivers a classic citrus duo that balances sharp, punchy Lemon with sweet, zesty Lime for a vibrant, refreshing taste from first puff to last. The blend is a perfectly balanced combination of fresh and fruity, sweet-sour flavour, making it a reliable all-day option for vapers who enjoy classic citrus flavours. Each JoinOne Prefilled Pod + Refill arrives ready to use with 2ml pod and 10ml refill container of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid and an integrated dual-mesh coil for consistent flavour delivery. Simply assemble then slide into the Mini Battery and snap it onto the larger battery (the one with the HD Screen) adjust the kit’s airflow to suit a tighter or looser mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw. When the pod is empty, simply replace it with a fresh one — no refilling or coil changes required. This pod keeps maintenance simple while offering clean, flavour in a compact format.
